title: Nā ʻUhane Māhoe Huki Pū i ke Ola
explanation:
# Twin Spirits Pulling Together

Two spiral galaxies 200 million light-years away are locked in a cosmic dance of destruction and creation, their swirling arms intertwining as gravity pulls them inexorably together. This spectacular collision, named by Hawaiian high school students "The Twin Spirits Pulling Together Creating Life," triggers an explosive burst of new star formation as the galaxies merge, forging the very elements that make up planets and life itself from their colliding clouds of gas and dust.
